newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 247 OF SEPTEMBER 28, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 247 OF SEPTEMBER 28, 1996.
